items.quote: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, LORD, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?
items.claim: Moses returned to the LORD and spoke, asking why God mistreated the people and sent him

items.quote: wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people?
why is it that thou hast sent me?
For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people
items.claim: Since Moses came to Pharaoh to speak in God's name, Pharaoh did evil to the people

items.quote: neither hast thou delivered thy people at all
items.claim: God did not deliver the people
